list.source: select "file_documents"."id", "file_documents"."project_id", "file_documents"."worker_id", "file_documents"."worktree_id", "file_documents"."protected_state", "file_documents"."created_at" from "file_documents" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "file_documents"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) where "file_documents"."project_id" = $2 order by "file_documents"."created_at" asc, "file_documents"."id" asc

get.source: select "file_documents"."id", "file_documents"."project_id", "file_documents"."worker_id", "file_documents"."worktree_id", "file_documents"."protected_state", "file_documents"."created_at" from "file_documents" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "file_documents"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) where "file_documents"."id" = $2

target.source: select "project_worktrees"."worker_id" from "project_worktrees" inner join "project_sources" on "project_sources"."id" = "project_worktrees"."project_source_id" inner join "projects" on "projects"."id" = "project_sources"."project_id" inner join "workers" on "workers"."id" = "project_worktrees"."worker_id" where ("projects"."owner_id" = $1 and "workers"."owner_id" = $2 and "workers"."unlinked_at" is null and "projects"."id" = $3 and "project_worktrees"."id" = $4 and "project_worktrees"."lifecycle_state" = $5 and "project_sources"."removed_at" is null) for update

insert.source: insert into "file_documents" ("id", "project_id", "worker_id", "worktree_id", "protected_state", "created_at") values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, default) on conflict do nothing returning "id", "project_id", "worker_id", "worktree_id", "protected_state", "created_at"

context.source: select "file_documents"."id", "file_documents"."project_id", "file_documents"."worker_id", "file_documents"."worktree_id", "file_documents"."protected_state", "file_documents"."created_at", "project_worktrees"."absolute_path" from "file_documents" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "file_documents"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) inner join "project_worktrees" on ("project_worktrees"."id" = "file_documents"."worktree_id" and "project_worktrees"."worker_id" = "file_documents"."worker_id" and "project_worktrees"."lifecycle_state" = $2) inner join "project_sources" on ("project_sources"."id" = "project_worktrees"."project_source_id" and "project_sources"."project_id" = "file_documents"."project_id" and "project_sources"."removed_at" is null) inner join "workers" on ("workers"."id" = "file_documents"."worker_id" and "workers"."owner_id" = $3 and "workers"."unlinked_at" is null) where "file_documents"."id" = $4
